mission.label: THE MISSION
mission.heading: Preserving stories. Celebrating faith. Inspiring generations.
paragraphs: Faith Heroes Africa exists to document the people, movements and moments that have shaped the Christian story across Africa.
From missionaries and ministers to revival movements, historic churches and emerging voices, we preserve stories that deserve to be remembered and shared with generations to come.
Our collection brings together the history, heritage and continuing movement of the Christian faith across the continent.

editorialStatement.statement: Some stories should not be forgotten.

founder.name: Emmanuel Olu Falodun
founder.title: Meet Emmanuel Olu Falodun
paragraphs: Emmanuel Olu Falodun is an author and pastor whose work is connected to documenting and communicating the story of faith in Africa.
Through Faith Heroes Africa and related platforms, the vision is to preserve important stories, honour Christian leaders and encourage future generations.
